en: Your son rejects the study path you chose for him.
ph_ar: ولدي رافض التخصص اللي اخترتو ليه
ph_en: My son refuses the field of study I picked for him

en: You find out your son is talking to strangers online.
ph_ar: اكتشفت أن بنتي تحكي مع غرباء على النت
ph_en: I found out my daughter chats with strangers online

en: You feel you do not spend enough time with your children.
ph_ar: ما عنديش وقت لأولادي وحاسس بالذنب
ph_en: I feel guilty that I don't spend enough time with my kids

en: Your child wants something beyond what you can afford.
ph_ar: بنتي تبي حاجة غالية وأنا ما نقدرش نشريهالها
ph_en: My child wants something I can't afford

en: You worry that you are too strict in raising your children.
ph_ar: أخاف أكون قاسي برشا مع أولادي
ph_en: I'm afraid I'm too harsh with my children

en: Your son keeps a secret and you feel he does not trust you.
ph_ar: ابني صار يخبي علي وحاسة ما يثقش فيا
ph_en: My son hides things from me and I feel he doesn't trust me

en: The family moves to a new city and the children struggle to adapt.
ph_ar: انتقلنا لمدينة جديدة والأولاد ما تأقلموش
ph_en: We moved cities and the kids can't settle in

en: The school keeps complaining about your child's behaviour.
ph_ar: المدرسة كل مرة تشتكي من تصرفات ولدي
ph_en: The school keeps complaining about my son's behaviour

en: Your son leaves home to study or work and you feel the emptiness.
ph_ar: ابني سافر يدرس والدار صارت فاضية علي
ph_en: My son moved out and the house feels empty

en: A friend lets you down when you needed them.
ph_ar: صاحبي خذلني وقت اللي كنت محتاجه
ph_en: My friend let me down when I needed him most

en: Someone passes on a secret you trusted them with.
ph_ar: قلتلها سر وراحت حكاتو للناس كاملين
ph_en: I told her a secret and she told everyone

en: You feel you are always the one who reaches out.
ph_ar: دايمًا أنا اللي نسأل على صحابي وحتى حد ما يسأل علي
ph_en: I'm always the one who texts first

en: You disagree with a friend about an opinion or a principle.
ph_ar: اختلفت مع صاحبي على مبدأ وتخاصمنا
ph_en: My friend and I fell out over a principle

en: Your friend succeeds and you feel jealous despite loving them.
ph_ar: صاحبتي نجحت وأنا نحس بغيرة رغم أني نحبها
ph_en: My best friend got the job and I feel jealous even though I love her

en: Your name is left out of a group invitation.
ph_ar: عزموا الشلة كلها إلا أنا
ph_en: Everyone was invited except me

en: A friend asks you for a favour that goes beyond your limits.
ph_ar: صاحبي طالب مني خدمة فوق طاقتي وما عرفتش نرفض
ph_en: A friend asked for a favour that's too much and I can't say no

en: You discover someone has been speaking badly about you.
ph_ar: عرفت أن واحد يتكلم علي بالسوء من وراي
ph_en: I found out someone has been talking behind my back

en: You meet an old friend after years without contact.
ph_ar: رجعت تلاقيت بصاحب قديم بعد سنين
ph_en: I reconnected with an old friend after years

en: You feel some of your friends take advantage of you.
ph_ar: حاسس صحابي يستغلوني وقت الحاجة برك
ph_en: I feel my friends only use me when they need something

en: You want to end a friendship that hurts you without wounding anyone.
ph_ar: بدي أبعد عن صاحبة مؤذية بدون ما أجرحها
ph_en: I want to end a toxic friendship without hurting her

en: You meet someone new and fear being rejected.
ph_ar: نخاف نتعرف على ناس جدد ويرفضوني
ph_en: I'm scared new people will reject me

en: You are mocked for your appearance or your accent.
ph_ar: يتمسخروا علي بسبب لهجتي
ph_en: People make fun of my accent

en: You find yourself between two friends who have fallen out.
ph_ar: صاحبيني متخاصمين وأنا محتار مع من نقف
ph_en: Two of my friends are fighting and I'm caught in between

en: You forget to return something you borrowed from a friend.
ph_ar: نسيت نرجع لصاحبي حاجة استلفتها
ph_en: I forgot to give back something I borrowed from a friend

en: A friend apologises but you doubt the apology is sincere.
ph_ar: اعتذر لي بس ما نيش مصدقه
ph_en: He apologised but I don't believe he means it

en: Your circumstances change and you drift away from your group of friends.
ph_ar: ظروفي تبدلت وبعدت على صحابي
ph_en: Life changed and I drifted away from my friends

en: You need to ask for help but feel embarrassed.
ph_ar: محتاج مساعدة بس نحشم نطلب
ph_en: I need help but I'm too embarrassed to ask

en: You help someone and then feel they did not appreciate it.
ph_ar: ساعدته بكل اللي نقدر وما قالش حتى شكرا
ph_en: I helped him and he didn't even say thank you

en: You misread a message and a problem arises because of it.
ph_ar: فهمت رسالتها غلط وصارت مشكلة كبيرة
ph_en: I misread her message and it caused a big fight

en: You start a new job and feel unsure of yourself.
ph_ar: بديت خدمة جديدة وما عنديش ثقة في روحي
ph_en: I just started a new job and I feel like I don't belong

en: A colleague takes credit for your work.
ph_ar: زميلي نسب الشغل اللي عملته لنفسه
ph_en: A colleague took credit for my work

en: Your manager criticises you in front of others.
ph_ar: مديري هزأني قدام الزملاء
ph_en: My boss criticised me in front of everyone

en: You are asked to finish work in an unrealistic time.
ph_ar: طالبين مني شغل ما يكملش في الوقت هذا
ph_en: They want me to finish an impossible amount of work by tomorrow

en: You are turned down after a job interview.
ph_ar: رفضوني في مقابلة الشغل للمرة العاشرة
ph_en: I got rejected after another job interview

en: You suddenly lose your job.
ph_ar: طردوني من الخدمة فجأة
ph_en: I lost my job out of nowhere

en: Your salary is late and your obligations are piling up.
ph_ar: الراتب تأخر والالتزامات تراكمت
ph_en: My salary is late and the bills keep coming

en: You are promoted and find it hard to manage your former colleagues.
ph_ar: ترقيت وصرت مسؤول على زملائي القدام
ph_en: I got promoted and now manage my old colleagues

en: You feel your salary does not match your responsibilities.
ph_ar: نخدم برشا والراتب ما يستاهلش
ph_en: I do so much and my salary is unfair

en: You make a professional mistake that affects the team.
ph_ar: غلطت غلطة في الخدمة وضرّت الفريق
ph_en: I made a mistake at work that affected the whole team

en: You witness unethical behaviour at work.
ph_ar: شفت تصرف مش أخلاقي في الشركة
ph_en: I saw something unethical happening at work

en: You are asked to hide important information from a client.
ph_ar: مديري طالب مني نخبي معلومة على الحريف
ph_en: My boss wants me to hide important information from a client

en: You disagree with a colleague about how to carry out a task.
ph_ar: تخاصمت مع زميلي على طريقة الشغل
ph_en: A colleague and I clash over how to do the work

en: You feel exhausted from constant pressure at work.
ph_ar: ضغط الشغل هلكني
ph_en: I'm burnt out from work pressure

en: You hesitate between staying in your job and accepting a new offer.
ph_ar: جاني عرض شغل جديد ومحتار نقبل ولا لا
ph_en: I got a new job offer and can't decide whether to take it

en: Your manager refuses a leave you need.
ph_ar: المدير رفض يعطيني إجازة وأنا محتاجها
ph_en: My manager refused the time off I really need

en: You have to work with someone you are not comfortable with.
ph_ar: مضطر نخدم مع واحد ما نرتاحلوش
ph_en: I have to work with someone I can't stand

en: Your contract is ending and you do not know whether it will be renewed.
ph_ar: العقد قرب يكمل وما نعرفش إذا باش يجددوه
ph_en: My contract ends soon and I don't know if they'll renew it

en: You receive harsh feedback on a project you put effort into.
ph_ar: تعبت على المشروع وجاتني ملاحظات قاسية
ph_en: I worked so hard on the project and got harsh feedback

en: You achieve professional success and find no time to celebrate it.
ph_ar: نجحت في الشغل بس ما لقيتش وقت نفرح
ph_en: I got a big win at work but I'm too busy to enjoy it
